prompt: Work in <fixture-project>. With no active task, process CASE for every eligible candidate. Review all CASE artifacts, present one batch approval request, then confirm and execute them serially after approval. Report the batch file and per-task states.
assertions: .workloom/workspace/case-batches/<batch-id>.md contains both task paths, distinct hashes, approval time, and execution states.
One approval covers the listed batch; each confirm uses its own current hash.
Execution is serial and preserves one active task at a time.
Any non-ready CASE is excluded from the batch and reported.
Light, completed, archived, and non-ready candidate directories remain byte-identical.
notes: With-skill-only acceptance. Planning and batch use iteration 2; ready, legacy and blocked use iteration 4 after the independent-approval prompt fix. No baseline run participates in this result. Superseded iteration-2 runs for ready/legacy/blocked are excluded from acceptance counts. total_tokens is the sum of per-response usage values, not unique content tokens, and is not used as a pass/fail metric.
